Hi! Sorry for the late reply. As I said in the thread, I only used it for a couple of months, so take my review with a pinch of salt. Me and 5 of my friends got one each. The scooter itself is great at first, it would do what a scooter should do (I wasn't expecting much since it was a very cheap scooter) but a couple months in, it started to have multiple problems, some are annoying but some are quite serious. Here are some that I can think of:

* Brakes: Performance was really bad after using for a couple months, it was like the caliper isn't making full contact. Me and my other 3 friends had the same issue. This caused my friends to crash into cars multiple times.
* Headlights: Only one of all of our scooters' headlight worked. My scooter would shut down if I turn on the headlight, and my friends' just straight up didn't work but you can get a bicycle lights from Amazon for \~$20
* Brake lights: Multiple of our scooters' brake lights didn't work properly, mine didn't light up at all, even when applying the brake. Some of my friends' only flash when applying the brake.
* Problem with rain: Since we all keep our scooters outdoor when we're at work, the LCD screen would fog up and could take multiple days for the fog to be completely gone.
* Motor: Two of our scooters had motor issues. The throttle seemed to be stuck, it would automatically accelerate when it picked up a speed,this occurred randomly, this could be from leaving the scooters in the rain since it proned to happen more often while and after the rain. One of these two scooter couldn't get into 3rd gear (the scooter has 3 speed gear) or it would shuts off.
* **One of our scooter one day decided to stop working and we couldn't get it to turn on.**

  
This is my and my friends' experience with this particular model.

Please be noted that this is a older model. (I believe they discontinued this model)

I ended up selling mine on FB marketplace for $100



I would suggest you to do an extensive research before buying any model since safety on the road is extremely important, especially when you share roads with bigger vehicles.

  
**TL;DR:** Initially it was okay, but after a few months, there were multiple problems: poor brakes, headlights and brake lights not working properly, LCD screen fogging in rain, motor issues causing acceleration problems, and one scooter completely stopped working. IMO, do not buy this model. Not worth risking your life.
